name: cdk-virtual-scrolling
description: Uses CdkVirtualScrollViewport with cdkVirtualFor to render only the rows currently visible in a large list, keeping the DOM small regardless of how many items the underlying array holds.
templateCode: {{ item }}
notes: itemSize must match each row's actual rendered height in pixels — if the CSS height drifts from itemSize, the viewport's scrollbar length and the visible window of rendered rows both become inaccurate.
The viewport needs an explicit height (via CSS) to know how many rows fit on screen; without one it collapses to zero height and renders nothing.

Every *cdkVirtualFor row should render at a uniform height — variable-height rows require a custom VirtualScrollStrategy, since the default FixedSizeVirtualScrollStrategy assumes itemSize is constant.
